simulation.mapping: The 600-second simulation axis uses sampled AudioContext sample-index anchors. Only the terminal anchor is reconciled to the decoded PCM frame count to account for measured Opus end padding/pre-skip.

zoom.note: Exactly 10 decoded-audio seconds, selected from simulation milestones; actual simulation span and contact timing are mapped through clock anchors. No normalization or padding.

fixedPreset.spectrogramAggregation: maximum fixed-dBFS frame value per overview pixel column and frequency row
fixedPreset.contactScale: 2400 individual FOOT_CONTACT contacts per 10-second bucket fills the fixed 28-pixel strip
fixedPreset.grayscale: fixed linear mapping from -100..0 dBFS; gamma 1; no content normalization
